verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Chroma is licensed under Apache 2.0, and its source lives in a public GitHub repo (chroma-core/chroma). Community comments independently describe it as a popular OSS project with an Apache 2.0 core. missing for 10: direct evidence of the repository's LICENSE file contents, clarity on whether Chroma Cloud-specific components are also open source (one comment refers to an open 'core').

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Chroma and Weaviate are both popular OSS projects, 21k and 14k stars respectively.
